title: RTP reorder timeout cannot expire without another packet
test: tests/fallbackRelayReorderFlush.test.js: 'a tail held behind a lost packet reaches the relay after the wait, though no packet follows', 'the flush timer is registered through the pipeline and goes with the fallback', 'a flush timer of a stopped start does not feed the newer start on the same pipeline'; tests/rtpReorder.test.js: 'held packets are released by poll() once the wait is over, without another packet', 'poll() before the wait is over returns nothing and keeps the packets for the missing one', 'poll() with nothing held returns nothing, however long it has been', 'poll() releases every held run in order, across a second gap, and counts each gap once', 'poll() leaves in-order delivery and the counters as push() has them'
proof: On the unchanged code the three relay-level tests failed: with a relay running, a keyframe and a frame fed, one frame's packet lost, the next frame held and no packet after it, advancing the injected clock past 120 ms and running the mocked timers left the held frame undelivered ('released once the wait is over, without another packet': 2 !== 3, relay.frames stayed at 2); the pipeline had no 'timer:reorder-flush' ('one flush timer, registered by name through pipeline.setTimer': 0 !== 1); and a second start on the same pipeline could not release its own held tail ("B's tail is released by B's timer": 1 !== 2). The five poll() tests failed with 'reorder.poll is not a function'. After the fix all eight pass: RtpReorderBuffer.poll() applies the same expiry rule as push() (shared _expired()), loops while it holds, returns the run in sequence order and counts lostPackets; startFallbackRelay feeds push() and poll() output through one function (feedReordered) and registers a setInterval (max(20, maxWaitMs/2) = 60 ms, unref'd) with pipeline.setTimer('reorder-flush', timer, clearInterval); each tick returns at once unless the start is still current. The tests use the injected clock and node:test mock timers, no real sleeps. The existing rtpReorder, fallbackRelayStaleStart, fallbackRelaySwitch, fallbackRelayAdaptation and roomMediaPipeline tests pass unchanged.
